name: pointer-surface
title: Pointer Surface
description: A surface that answers the pointer: a soft light that follows it across a card, a slight tilt toward it, or both. It is the feel of picking a card up off a table, for a grid of choices a reader is weighing (plans, sessions, topics), not for every box on a…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/pointer-surface

Installed to `components/ui/effects/pointer-surface.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/pointer-surface';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/pointer-surface

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
